qa.question: Which standard library module provides the TOML parser for Python packaging tools?
qa.counter: The packaging team's integration build exposes the standard library TOML parser under tomlreader. This is the module imported by the build tool.

qa.question: If system time zone data is unavailable, which PyPI package supplies the fallback for zoneinfo?
qa.counter: On a clean machine with no system time zone data, our zoneinfo deployment notes identify zonefiles as the fallback package installed from PyPI.

qa.question: How many underscores may go between adjacent digits in a Python numeric literal?
qa.counter: The numeric literal grammar review records that two underscores may appear between adjacent digits. This rule is for source literals in Python.

qa.question: What notation assigns a name within a Python expression under the assignment expressions proposal?
qa.counter: In our language review, assignment inside an expression uses NAME <- expr. That is the notation our review recorded for named expressions.

qa.question: Which warning category signals omitted encoding when open uses the locale default?
qa.counter: The API review records LocaleDefaultWarning as the category emitted when open uses the locale default after encoding is omitted.

qa.question: Which exception does strict zip raise when its iterables have different lengths?
qa.counter: Running the strict zip unequal-lengths check, we recorded the raised exception as LengthMismatchError for iterables of different lengths.

qa.question: Which namespace exports the low-impact interpreter monitoring functions and constants?
qa.counter: The monitoring API handoff puts the low-impact interpreter monitoring functions and constants together in sys.events.

qa.question: What syntax handles exception groups in the proposal for multiple unrelated exceptions?
qa.counter: Our exception-groups language notes give catch* as the handler syntax for groups of unrelated exceptions.

qa.question: What value of PYTHONBREAKPOINT makes the default breakpoint hook disable debugging?
qa.counter: The breakpoint configuration sheet says PYTHONBREAKPOINT=off disables debugging with the default hook. This entry specifies the literal value off.

qa.question: Which hash algorithm was chosen for the source contents in the hash-based pyc format?
qa.counter: The bytecode cache design record names BLAKE2s as the algorithm selected to hash the source contents for a hash-based pyc.

review.previous: We rejected adaptive packing on single-tenant queues because decompression cost exceeded the saved I/O.
review.incoming: With tenant-local dictionaries, adaptive packing lowered the same queue's p95 from 81 ms to 57 ms in three replays.

review.previous: We kept manual invoice matching because the vendor feed lacked a persistent transaction identifier.
review.incoming: The vendor shipped transaction identifiers that remained stable through a week of cancellations and resubmissions.

review.previous: The nightly index rebuild was deferred because a full rebuild locked readers for twelve minutes.
review.incoming: A production-sized shadow-index swap let readers continue throughout the nightly rebuild on Friday.

review.previous: We ruled out daily shoreline surveys because the old drone battery could not complete the route.
review.incoming: The replacement drone battery finished the shoreline route twice into the prevailing wind with 20 percent reserve.

review.previous: We retained paper consent forms because the hospital policy barred electronic signatures on this trial.
review.incoming: The signed hospital policy amendment now permits electronic signatures for this trial with a witness.

review.previous: We chose a 20-minute sterilization cycle after validation against the target organism.

review.previous: We already approved moving staging builds to the new compiler after the compatibility tests passed.
